Close all Termix terminal sessions before backing up. Save the backup in Downloads or another folder outside Termix. Terminal processes and temporary files are excluded. The backup may contain passwords and private keys.
Have the backup and the separate recovery key ready. You can restore your data before using this new installation.

Termix read the entire encrypted backup back and verified it. Confirm you have the saved file and its separate recovery key before uninstalling. The official app needs both to restore your data.
